## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Jarāmaraṇaṁvipākotikathā* (Kv 7.8) is an Abhidhamma debate located in the seventh chapter of the *Kathāvatthu* [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. The discussion addresses the controverted thesis *jarāmaraṇaṁ vipāko ti*—whether old age and death are to be regarded as karmic resultants (*vipāka*) [Dube 1980]. According to SuttaCentral, the text has been translated into one modern language [SuttaCentral].
Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus records any external cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali canon, DharmaNexus records widespread textual reuse, detecting 472 matching passages shared across 29 texts [DharmaNexus]. The closest reuse partners consist of adjacent and related *Kathāvatthu* debates concerning resultant states and material phenomena, notably *Rūpaṁkammantikathā* (Kv 8.9), *Pathavīkammavipākotikathā* (Kv 7.7), *Rūpaṁkusalākusalantikathā* (Kv 16.7), *Saḷāyatanakathā* (Kv 12.4), *Saddovipākotikathā* (Kv 12.3), and *Rūpaṁvipākotikathā* (Kv 16.8) [DharmaNexus]. Additional textual matches align with canonical treatments of aggregates and causal conditions in the *Khandhavibhaṅga* (Vb 1), the *Paṭṭhāna* (Patthana 1.3), and the *Nidāna Saṁyutta* of the *Saṁyutta Nikāya* (SN 12) [DharmaNexus].
